exact_result: For genuine global weak H2 L2 jets d,e of f on WeakGrushin.Space kappa, with f supported almost everywhere on a compact K and |p.1 i|<=R there, R>0, the actual integral of |f|^2 is at most 4 R^2 times the actual integral of |d(yDir i)|^2. A stronger API needs the coordinate bound only almost everywhere where f is nonzero. A general continuous linear coordinate L and direction v with L(v)=1 are also handled.
proof: The radius-free oscillator inequality is transferred using the proved compact weak H2 approximation and continuous weighted L2 convergence on the common larger compact support. The slab weight bound is then applied only to the actual limiting f, so no unsupported slab-radius claim is made about its approximants. Scalar absorption uses a=(2 R^2)^(-1).
